page_title: Get Cited by AI & Rank Higher on Google with Frizerly AI

sources.entry: Frizerly - AI agent that learns your business and competitors to automatically publish SEO blogs. #paid

summary.name: Frizerly
summary.one_liner: Frizerly is an AI marketing agent suite that learns a business's website and automatically publishes SEO blogs and social content, plus handles AI visibility, reviews, chat, Reddit, email and simple web app building.
use_cases: get recommended by ChatGPT and Perplexity
manage and reply to Google Business reviews
find Reddit threads to join for leads
summary.what_it_does: Frizerly connects to a website (Shopify, WordPress, Webflow, HubSpot or custom sites), learns the business and competitors, and publishes SEO-optimized blogs weekly (daily on PRO). It uses Google Search Console data and keyword tracking to pick topics, and says it includes products and images in posts. Additional agents cover AEO monitoring across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity, drafting Google review replies with daily summaries, an AI website chat widget for lead capture, Reddit thread discovery, AI-drafted email newsletters, and chat-based landing page and web app building. A case study claims 360 blogs produced 600+ monthly organic clicks for an optometry practice.
notable: Eight AI agents covering SEO, AEO, social, reviews, support chat, Reddit, email and app building
Connects to Google Search Console to target real search queries
Auto-drafts and posts Google Business review replies based on custom rules
Compared against Semrush and Ahrefs as an automated alternative to research toolkits
caveats: Listed with a #paid tag in the source listing, and daily publishing is limited to the PRO tier
Case study and '100+ businesses' figures are vendor claims, not independently verified
Page does not state specific prices
